facts: Borders Syria, Iraq, Saudi Arabia and Israel
Highest point is Jabal Umm ad Dami
worth_knowing: A small coastline on the Red Sea in the southwest, separated from Egypt by the Gulf of Aqaba. The Jordan River flows into the Dead Sea along the western border, in the Jordan Rift Valley.
